name: OpenMemory MCP
tagline: Your private, local memory layer for all AI tools
description: OpenMemory MCP is a private, local-first memory layer with a built-in UI, compatible with all MCP-clients. It ensures all memory stays local, structured, and under your control with no cloud sync or external storage.
detailed_description: OpenMemory MCP is a private, local-first memory layer designed to provide a shared, persistent memory infrastructure for AI tools that support the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It enables AI clients to store, retrieve, and manage memory objects locally on the user's machine, ensuring data sovereignty and privacy by avoiding cloud storage. The system uses a vector store backend (Qdrant) for semantic indexing of memories, allowing efficient and meaningful memory search and retrieval. It supports full audit logging and fine-grained access control, including the ability to pause or revoke client access at the application or memory level. OpenMemory MCP runs on local infrastructure using Docker, Postgres, and Qdrant, and includes a built-in UI for memory visibility, auditing, and manual control. By providing a unified memory layer across different AI tools, it solves the problem of context loss and fragmented memory in AI workflows, enabling seamless context handoff and persistent learning across sessions and applications.
